detail: CLAUDE.md is the single source of truth for gate definitions (persistent, survives context compression). SessionStart prompt is now a 40-token pointer to CLAUDE.md. Skills focus on HOW-TO workflows with third-person descriptions and when-to-use triggers for discovery. MCP instructions remain as condensed fallback for non-plugin clients.
summary: Layered instruction architecture: CLAUDE.md as authority, lean SessionStart prompt, third-person skill descriptions
